tool_call_format: [TOOL_CALLS]<name>[ARGS]<json-arguments> in the assistant turn; tool definitions in [AVAILABLE_TOOLS]<json>[/AVAILABLE_TOOLS]; tool results in [TOOL_RESULTS]<text>[/TOOL_RESULTS]
known_template_errors: Only user, assistant and tool roles are supported, got developer. (any developer message)
After the optional system message, conversation roles must alternate user and assistant roles except for tool calls and results. (two user turns in a row, a system message that is not messages[0])
Only text chunks are supported in assistant message contents. (assistant content block of type thinking; b11960's Ministral-3 handler injects one when reasoning_content is set)
Only text, image and image_url chunks are supported in user message content. (unknown block type in a user message)
Only text chunks are supported in system message contents. (non-text block in the system message)
Unsloth custom template does not support years > 2032. Error year = [YYYY] (strftime_now returns a year above 2032 on a 1st of the month)
notes: Mistral [SYSTEM_PROMPT]/[INST] format. The template has no thinking or effort variable at all: enable_thinking, reasoning_effort, reasoning_strength, medium_effort and thinking are silently ignored, and add_generation_prompt adds nothing because generation follows the last [/INST]. When the first message is not a system message the template injects a ~2.5 KB default Le Chat system prompt that embeds today's and yesterday's date. Only messages[0] may be a system message. b11960 detects this template as Ministral 3 ([SYSTEM_PROMPT]+[TOOL_CALLS]+[ARGS], no [CALL_ID]) and runs common_chat_params_init_ministral_3, which claims supports_thinking=true with [THINK]/[/THINK] tags and rewrites system/assistant content into typed blocks; the template itself never emits or accepts thinking, so an assistant history entry with reasoning_content becomes a thinking block and raises 'Only text chunks are supported in assistant message contents.'. The template's 'Assistant message must have a string or a list of chunks' raise is patched to 'if false' by b11960 for [TOOL_CALLS] templates.
